item.title: Is Mike Vrabel missing Stefon Diggs - New England Patriots coach’s “not very deep” comment raises questions about AJ Brown’s importance
item.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel of the New England Patriots has pointed out the team’s critical lack of depth, igniting a conversation regarding player significance and roster dynamics. With numerous recent player changes, Vrabel elaborated that his focus lies in developing late-round draft picks and backup talent. The Patriots are determined to bolster their team’s resilience in anticipation of the new season.
